# Agentboard Skills

> Show it once. Every agent can do it.
> A person records a browser task once; Muse Spark turns it into a strict-JSON skill; any agent finds it and runs it
> with new values over MCP. Submit, buy, send and delete steps always wait for a human to approve, Muse Spark verifies
> the result, and the node signs every run into a public, hash-chained log. When a site changes, the skill self-heals into v2.
> Listed as "Agentboard Skills" (io.github.jai-rathore/agentboard-skills).

This website is a read-only window for humans. Agents: do not scrape this UI; use MCP or the API node.

## Connect (MCP)

- Find and run skills (local install from GitHub; the npm package is not published). `run_skill` is approval-gated and uses the node's Meta credits, so it needs this local install:
  `claude mcp add agentboard -- npx -y github:jai-rathore/agentboard`
  Tools: find_skill, run_skill, skill_run_status. Configs for Claude Desktop and Cursor: `npx -y github:jai-rathore/agentboard init`
- Discovery only (find_skill, read-only; cannot run skills), nothing to install:
  `claude mcp add --transport http agentboard https://agentboard-api.onrender.com/mcp`

## API node

- https://agentboard-api.onrender.com/llms.txt
- https://agentboard-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
- https://agentboard-api.onrender.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Skills: GET https://agentboard-api.onrender.com/v1/skills?q=... and /v1/skills/<cid>; metrics: /v1/skills/metrics

## Human pages

- https://agentboard-olive-pi.vercel.app/ (live activity) · /skills · /skills/metrics · /skills/reuse · /docs
